scenarios.name: zero_input_stationary
scenarios.description: 30 empty frames, stage entities: player never moves, no eat/flee events, growMeter stays 0

scenarios.name: mouse_swim_toward_target
scenarios.description: camera pitch -0.3; 15 frames mouse at NDC center (stationary), then 45 frames at NDC (0.5, 0): the ray-plane target lands on +X, the player swims +X on the swim plane

scenarios.name: eat_food_keyboard
scenarios.description: 20 frames thrust-right (turn toward food_a), then 100 frames thrust-forward: the player swims into food_a, an eat event fires, growMeter becomes 1, food_a is culled; prey_c untouched

scenarios.name: flee_from_prey
scenarios.description: prey_test at (0, 0, -3), inside fleeRadius 4.0 of the origin; 40 empty frames: flee events while the player is within fleeRadius, the player is pushed +Z (faces away, boosted); flee stops once it escapes the radius

scenarios.name: keyboard_only_fallback
scenarios.description: stage entities; 30 frames thrust-forward+boost (swims +Z), then 30 frames thrust-back (retreats): final position is short of the origin, no events (food_a and prey_c stay out of range)

scenarios.name: background_world_plane_switch
scenarios.description: plane point {0,0,-50} (a per-world swim plane); camera pitch -0.3; 10 frames mouse at NDC center, then 40 frames at NDC (0.5, 0): the ray-plane target lands on the z=-50 plane, the player swims toward +X and -Z

scenarios.name: advect_velocity_settle
scenarios.description: 20 frames thrust-forward (vel builds), then 40 empty frames: vel damps exponentially toward zero, pos drifts then settles; no events, growMeter 0

scenarios.name: multi_cell_combat_flee
scenarios.description: 3 prey inside fleeRadius 4.0 of the origin at (2,0,-2), (3,1,-3), (1,-1,-2); 30 empty frames: flee events while prey are in range, player faces away + boosts

scenarios.name: camera_zoom_scale
scenarios.description: camera pitch -0.3; 20 frames mouse NDC (0.5,0) at zoom 1.0, then 20 frames at zoom 2.0: the zoomed-in eye shifts the ray-plane target, changing the steer point
